i ) o n 1 9 . 0 1 . 2 0 1 7 , s a m p l e o f " B e s a n " w a s t a k e n b y t h e F o o d S a f e t y O f f i c e r ( " F S O " i n s h o r t ) f o r a n a l y s i s b y p u r c h a s i n g t h e s a m e f r o m S h . D e e e p a k J i n d a l S / o S h . S h r i p a l J i n d a l ,

after hearing both the sides, imposed a  p e n a l t y o f R s . 8 0 , 0 0 0 /  a n d R s . 2 0 , 0 0 0 /

They have challenged the impugned order interalia, on the grounds that :
i ) t h e a p p e l l a n t n o . 1 h a d n e v e r a c c e p t e d t h e c h a r g e l e v e l e d against him that the sample food article was misbranded.
Nor did he plead guilty.
Even  otherwise, the penalty imposed by the Ld. ADM is not reasonable;

i i ) n o o p p o r t u n i t y o f p e r s o n a l h e a r i n g / p r o p e r o p p o r t u n i t y of making submissions through a legal professional was given to the appellant; 
i i i ) L d . A D M d i d n o t a p p r e c i a t e t h a t t h e p r o c e d u r e a s p r e s c r i b e d u n d e r t h e R u l e 2 .
4 o f t h e F S S R u l e s , 2 0 1 1 w a s not complied with while taking the sample or sending it for analysis

5 F S S ( P & L ) R e g u l a t i o n s a s n o s u c h v i o l a t i o n w a s mentioned either in the Food Analyst's Report or in the complaint filed by the FSO;
v i ) L d . A D M f a i l e d t o a p p r e c i a t e t h e p r o v i s i o n o f S e c t i o n 49 FSS Act while determining the quantum of penalty.

3.0 On the other hand, Ld. Chief Public Prosecutor sought dismissal of this appeal  s u b m i t t i n g t h a t t h e a p p e l l a n t s c a n n o t b e allowed to challenge the impugned order having admitted their guilt before the Ld. ADM.

t h o u g h i t c l a i m e d t o b e A g m a r k c e r t i f i e d . A d m i t t e d l y , t h e a p p e l l a n t s d i d n o t
file any reply before the Ld. ADM.

Perusal of the Trial Court record reveals that on 28.09.2017, 
the representative of the appellants admitted lapse on their part about non mentioning of the aforesaid details on the label.

It is seen that the impugned order records that " t h e r e s p o n d e n t s w e r e e x p l a i n e d t h e n a t u r e o f o f f e n c e a l l e g e d t o h a v e b e e n c o m m i t t e d b y t h e m . T h e y d o n o t o p p o s e t h e a l l e g a t i o n s .
They have not submitted any written submission in the matter but pleaded guilty during the  h e a r i n g .

" I n v i e w o f t h e s a m e , t h e a p p e l l a n t s c a n n o t n o w t u r n a r o u n d a n d s a y t h a t t h e y w e r e n o t g i v e n p r o p e r o p p o r t u n i t y o f h e a r i n g o r t h a t t h e y w e r e n o t a l l o w e d t o b e represented through a legal professional
. As per Trial Court record, no such request was ever made.
6 . 0 I n v i e w o f t h e a b o v e , a d m i t t e d l y l a b e l d i d n o t h a v e F S S A I logo & license number which is in violation of Regulation 2.2.1.7 of FSS (P&L) Regulations.

Further, Regulations 2.2.2.8, 2.2.2.9, 2.2.2.10 of FSS (P&L) Regulations, require that label  on every package of food article shall mention lot number, batch number,
c o d e n u m b e r a n d s h a l l a l s o m e n t i o n t h e d a t e o f m a n u f a c t u r i n g a n d p a c k i n g a n d a l s o B e s t B e f o r e i n C a p i t a l L e t t e r s . B u t l a b e l o n t h e sample food article did not conform to the same. 
6 .

1 T h e a p p e l l a n t s i n t h i s a p p e a l h a v e s t a t e d t h a t w i t h o u t u n d e r s t a n d i n g t h e n a t u r e a n d c o n s e q u e n c e s o f p l e a d i n g g u i l t y , t h e y accepted their guilt, although they had a good defence and wanted to file reply.
6.2 During the course of these proceedings, an enquiry was made with Ld. counsel for the

I n v i e w t h e s a m e , I n e e d n o t g o a n y f u r t h e r i n t o the other contentions as raised by the appellants.

7 . 0 T h e a b o v e a d m i t t e d c o n t r a v e n t i o n s r e n d e r e d t h e f o o d a r t i c l e a s m i s b r a n d e d i n t e r m s o f s e c t i o n 3 ( 1 ) ( z f ) ( A ) ( i ) ( C ) ( i ) o f the FSS Act.
Section 26 FSS Act makes it obligatory for the Food Business Operator to ensure  compliance of above provisions.

3 S e c t i o n 2 6 ( 2 ) ( i i ) F S S A c t w h i c h d e f i n e s " R e s p o n s i b i l i t i e s o f t h e food business operator" reads as under :
(1) Every food business operator shall ensure that the articles of food satisfy the requirements of this Act and the rules and regulations made thereunder  a t a l l s t a g e s o f p r o d u c t i o n , p r o c e s s i n g , i m p o r t ,
distribution and sale within the businesses under his control. 
(2) No food business operator shall himself or by any person on his  behalf manufacture, store, sell or distribute any article of food   (i) ....
(ii) which is misbranded or substandard or contains extraneous matter;
7.1

Nondischarge of the above obligation/ manufacturing/sale etc. of misbranded food  is made punishable under Section 52 FSS Act, which reads as under :
" 5 2 . P e n a l t y f o r m i s b r a n d e d f o o d (1) Any person who whether by himself or by any other person on his behalf manufactures for sale or stores or sells or distributes or imports any article of food for human consumption which is misbranded
, shall be liable to a penalty which may extend to three lakh rupees."

7.2 The Ld. ADM has imposed only a consolidated penalty of Rs.1,00,000/, to be shared in  the proportion of 80% by the manufacturer/Supplier & 20% by the Food Business Operator, 
 as against the maximum prescribed penalty of Rs. Three Lakhs.

7 . 3 I t m a y b e m e n t i o n e d t h a t l a b e l o n t h e s a m p l e p a c k a g e s i m p l y m e n t i o n e d t h a t t h e f o o d a r t i c l e w a s b e s t b e f o r e 6 0 d a y s f r o m t h e d a t e o f p a c k a g i n g .
B u t , i t d i d n o t b e a r t h e d a t e o f p a c k a g i n g .

T h u s , t h e c o n s u m e r h a d n o w a y o f k n o w i n g t h e d a t e t i l l w h i c h t h e f o o d a r t i c l e c o u l d b e c o n s u m e d . T h e s a m e c o u l d h a v e e x p o s e d t h e c o n s u m e r t o s e r i o u s h e a l t h h a z a r d .

F u r t h e r , t h e l a b e l d i d n o t e v e n m e n t i o n t h e l o t n u m b e r . I n c a s e o f a n y s u c h p r o b l e m a r i s i n g , t h e r e w a s n o w a y o f r e a c h i n g t h e l o t , t o w h i c h t h e s a m p l e f o o d p a c k e t belonged, for taking necessary action
. Not only this, the label did not even mention license  number and FSSAI logo and Agmark serial number.

7 . 4 I n v i e w o f t h e a b o v e f a c t s a n d c i r c u m s t a n c e s , t h e a p p e l l a n t s h a v e f a i l e d t o d e m o n s t r a t e a n y r e a s o n f o r i m p o s i t i o n o f penalty lower than what was imposed by the Ld. ADM

.

sentences.text: In view of the above facts and circumstances and the findings recorded in  preceding paras, the penalty imposed vide impugned order does not call for any  interference.
Appeal is therefore, dismissed.
9.0 Trial court record be returned along with copy of this judgment.
10.0 File be consigned to Record Room.
